name: com.vuntum/mcp
title: Vuntum
description: Sourced, dated data on consumer robots and physical AI: specs, prices, availability, evidence.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Definitions of the levels of evidence, the statuses, the freshness limits and the confidence score that come with every Vuntum value, as written on the methodology page. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_editorial_scope
tools.description: What Vuntum follows first (humanoids and physical AI), what it follows less (non-humanoid vacuum cleaners, simple lawn mowers and other small household robots) and what it no longer follows (defence is never published automatically), with the date of the last update. Read it to know what to expect, and what not to expect, from the database and the news. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Full-text search over the published robot sheets: accents ignored, word starts, synonyms, close spelling, ranked by relevance. `matchQuality` says whether all the words, some of them or a close spelling were found. `locale: "fr"` for French texts and addresses.

query.description: Words to look for in the robot sheets, for example "humanoid kitchen" or "Unitree G1" (2 to 120 characters).

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: The site search: robots, manufacturers and articles (full article text included). Can be filtered by type. Returns the type, title, summary and address of each result. `locale: "fr"` for French.

query.description: Words to look for in robots, manufacturers and articles (2 to 120 characters).

types.description: Keep only these kinds of results. All three when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: A published article (text, date, sources) from its URL identifier (the `slug` of an article result, in the same language). `locale: "fr"` for French.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Full sheet of a published robot: summary, form, use, utilities, characteristics, prices, availability, sources, product identifiers (`identifiers`: ASIN per Amazon marketplace, GTIN, manufacturer part number). `locale: "fr"` for French.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_robot_claims
tools.description: All the validated claims (facts) of one robot sheet: value, level of evidence, source, date and quote. Use `get_robot` for the summary sheet, this tool for every fact; `predicate` narrows to one fact. `locale: "fr"` for French values.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

predicate.description: Keep only one fact, by its key, for example "price.msrp" or "dimensions.height". All facts when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_robot_sources
tools.description: Sources behind the published claims of one robot: name, address, kind (manufacturer, independent media, marketplace, research lab) and date read. Use it to cite or check where a value comes from. `locale: "fr"` for French source names.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_robot_prices
tools.description: Observed prices of one robot by market (country), price type (list price, street price, preorder deposit, subscription, quote only) and date, each with its source. Vuntum sells nothing: these are prices seen at the manufacturer or retailers. `locale: "fr"` for French notes.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_robot_availability
tools.description: Whether one robot can be bought, preordered or only announced, by market (country), with the date it was observed and its source. `locale: "fr"` for French notes.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_humanoid_tracker
tools.description: Dated state of each humanoid robot: announced, pre-order, on sale, at a customer, in France, each with its date and source page, and the gap with the date the maker promised. A stage set to null is not established by a dated public source: it is not a "no". `stage` keeps the robots whose furthest stage it is. `locale: "fr"` for French notes.

stage.description: Keep only the humanoids at this stage of commercialisation. All stages when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Comparison of 2 to 4 published robots on the columns of the Vuntum comparison. Each row says whether the values differ (`differs`); `differingPredicates` lists what sets the robots apart, `missingByRobot` what is not disclosed. `locale: "fr"` for French.

items.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

slugs.description: URL identifiers of the 2 to 4 robot sheets to compare, for example ["g1", "h1"].

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: find_home_robots
tools.description: Published robots with a validated, sourced claim that they handle household tasks. For one precise utility use `find_robots_by_utility`. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: find_robots_by_utility
tools.description: Published robots that have a given utility (the keys are the site's French slugs): menage, jardin, cuisine, compagnie, education, loisirs, aide-personne, medical, reeducation, recherche, logistique, livraison, accueil, nettoyage-pro, inspection, construction, agriculture, industrie, exploration, telepresence, secours, defense-securite, polyvalent, autres. A robot often has several (`utilities` field of each sheet). `locale: "en"` gives the English label and page.

utility.description: One utility key from the list above, for example "menage".

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: find_robots_by_capability
tools.description: Published robots with a validated claim behind each requested capability: marcher, courir, escaliers, se-relever, saisir, plier-linge, ranger, navigation, parler. Never inferred from a category: each capability returns the claim, its source and its level of evidence. `locale: "fr"` for French.

capabilities.description: Capabilities that every returned robot must have demonstrated (1 to 9, from the list above).

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: find_programmable_robots
tools.description: Published robots that developers can program: public SDK, Python API, ROS or MCP, each with its source. Selected by fixed rules, never guessed by a model. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Robotics fairs, competitions and conferences: coming or running, and ended less than 90 days ago. Each event gives its dates, place and the official page it comes from with the date it was last read. Filter by `country` (name in French or English) and `kind` (fair, competition, conference). `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_corrections
tools.description: The public corrections log: what was wrong, what was corrected and when, newest first. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_competition_results
tools.description: Rankings of robotics competitions (team, robot, rank, discipline, autonomy) with the official ranking page and the date it was last read. Filter by `competition` (slug or part of the name) and `year`. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

competition.description: Competition slug or part of its name, for example "robocup".

year.description: Edition year of the competition, for example 2025.

tools.name: get_upcoming_releases
tools.description: Robots announced for pre-order or waitlist, or with a first shipping date still to come, soonest first. Each date and state carries its source page and the day it was last verified. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_company_figures
tools.description: Funding and headcount figures of robot companies, each with the company page it comes from and the date it is valid at. Filter by `company` (maker slug or part of the name). `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

company.description: Maker slug or part of the company name, for example "agility-robotics".

tools.name: get_integrators
tools.description: System integrators and the robot-maker programmes they claim, with the quoted words, who wrote them (maker or integrator), the page and its dates. Quotes are third-party text. Filter by `maker` (slug) and `country` (ISO code). `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

maker.description: Slug of the robot maker whose programme the integrators claim, for example "abb".

country.description: Country of the integrator as a two-letter ISO code, for example "FR".

tools.name: get_component_suppliers
tools.description: Who supplies which component (actuators, sensors, chips...) to which robot, each line with the official page that says so and the date it was last read. Filter by `company` (slug or part of the name), `component` and `robot` (slug). `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

company.description: Supplier slug or part of the company name.

component.description: Kind of component, matched exactly without regard to case, for example "motor" or "sensor".

robot.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet that uses the component, for example "g1".

tools.name: get_guides
tools.description: The published buyer guides, newest first, with title, standfirst, publication date and address. Use `get_article` with the slug for the full text and its sources. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_authors
tools.description: The authors who sign Vuntum articles, with name, biography in the requested language (null when none is written in it) and the address of the author page. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: The Vuntum glossary of robotics and physical AI terms, with definition, related terms and the references each definition was checked against. `query` filters by term or word. `locale: "fr"` for French.

query.description: Words to look for in the project names and descriptions, for example "ROS 2". All projects when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: The rankings and « best for » pages (lightest, fastest, highest payload, price bands, abilities). Without `slug`, the pages the data supports today; with a slug (French or English address), the robots in order with value, source and verification day. Each ranking is ordered by one published criterion. `locale: "fr"` for French.

slug.description: Address of one ranking page, from the list.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_observatory
tools.description: The figures of the published catalogue: robots by segment, form, country and year of announcement, claims by evidence level, official prices by band (each price in its own currency, never converted, with its source and verification day). `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: The latest public changes, newest first: new sheets, corrections, price and status changes, each with its date and page. For a date range or paging use `get_change_history`. `locale: "fr"` for French sentences.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_change_history
tools.description: PRO KEY ONLY. Complete public history of changes (prices, availability, corrected values), beyond the 50 of `get_recent_changes`, filterable by robot (`slug`), kind and dates (`from`, `to`, YYYY-MM-DD). Paged with `offset`; `locale: "fr"` for French sentences. Without a pro key the answer points to https://vuntum.com/en/business#demande.

limit.description: Maximum number of changes (100 by default, 200 max).

offset.description: Number of changes to skip, to read the next page.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: get_fact_sources
tools.description: PRO KEY ONLY. For one robot (`slug`), every accepted observation of each fact (same predicate, same conditions): all the sources that state it, replaced and outdated values included, each with its source, dates and level of evidence. `predicate` narrows to one fact (e.g. price.msrp). `locale: "fr"` for French values. Without a pro key the answer points to https://vuntum.com/en/business#demande.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".

predicate.description: Keep only one fact, by its key, for example "price.msrp" or "dimensions.height". All facts when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

tools.name: search_open_source_projects
tools.description: Open source repositories related to robotics listed by Vuntum. No English description is written for a repository: with `locale: "en"` only the repository's own words are returned.

query.description: Words to look for in the project names and descriptions, for example "ROS 2". All projects when omitted.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.
